_comment: Carried over from 05293190AC (gaps filled through 05293013AC) by tools/port.py; do not edit by hand, edit the reference annotations and re-run.

units.spark: degrees BTDC = x / 2 (signed tables: two's complement)
units.pos256: position 0-255 along the rows (or columns) of a 3D table
units.tempdiff: deg C = x (a difference of two temperatures)

0EE2.name: BattTempHeatFactor
0EE2.desc: Battery temperature model: factor on the excess above 110 against coolant (engine heat), into BattTempStored; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

4064.name: ResetCoolantInit
4064.desc: At reset: IdleRpmRefStart against start coolant temperature; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

4070.name: FlexLearnEthanolCurve
4070.desc: Flex-fuel learning: curve from FlexLearnLevel1/FlexLearnLevel2 to FlexLearnEthanol1/FlexLearnEthanol2

4094.name: CrankEthanolScale
4094.desc: Cranking: flex-fuel ethanol content to row position of CrankEthanolCoolant

048F.name: PartThrottleMapScale
048F.desc: MAP to row position of the part-throttle spark and fuel tables

0483.name: WotMapScale
0483.desc: MAP to row position of the WOT spark and fuel tables

0F9F.name: FlexEthanolScale
0F9F.desc: Flex-fuel: ethanol content (FlexEthanol) to the scaled value FlexEthanolScaled used as table input

4136.name: RpmCurveV0C4A
4136.desc: Engine rpm (high byte) to RpmCurveValue; all points 255 in the reference image

4142.name: IdleEnrichEthanolScale
4142.desc: Flex-fuel ethanol content to row position of IdleEnrichEthanolAirTemp

06A6.name: TipInThrottleIndex
06A6.desc: Tip-in enrichment: throttle opening to row index 1-9 of TipInMatrix

06BA.name: TipInRateIndex
06BA.desc: Tip-in enrichment: throttle opening step to column index 1-9 of TipInMatrix

0F87.name: DecelLeanRpmScale
0F87.desc: Deceleration enleanment: rpm to row position of DecelLeanAirflow

0F93.name: DecelLeanThrottleScale
0F93.desc: Deceleration enleanment: throttle opening to column position of DecelLeanAirflow

04CB.name: DecelLeanTimeScale
04CB.desc: Deceleration enleanment: time since start to row position of DecelLeanTimeCoolant

04E3.name: IacFuelScale
04E3.desc: Extra idle air (IacTargetCmd minus IacPosition) to row position of IacFuelCoolant

42CC.name: PurgeFuelMapScale
42CC.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: MAP to row position of PurgeFuelBase

42C2.name: PurgeFuelRpm
42C2.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: engine rpm to column position of PurgeFuelBase

4118.name: CoolantSparkMapScale
4118.desc: MAP to row position of CoolantSparkMap

04BF.name: AirTempSparkMapScale
04BF.desc: MAP to row position of AirTempSparkMapRpm

04D7.name: AfterStartSparkMapScale
04D7.desc: MAP to row position of AfterStartSparkMapRpm

049B.name: SurgeDecayGearScale
049B.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm/speed ratio (gear) to row position of SurgeDecay

0513.name: IdleBattTempScale
0513.desc: Battery temperature to row position of IdleBattTempTarget

051F.name: IacRollThrottleScale
051F.desc: IAC target while rolling: throttle opening to row position of IacRollThrottleRpm

04B3.name: IacCoastSpeedScale
04B3.desc: Vehicle speed to row position of IacCoastSpeedRpm

4333.name: IacFieldDutyScale
4333.desc: Filtered duty of the CS2 input $106E.5 (probably the generator field) to row position of IacFieldDutyRpm

433F.name: IacBaroScale
433F.desc: Barometric pressure to row position of IacBaseBaroTarget and IdleMapBase

058A.name: CrankPulseCoolantFactor
058A.desc: Factor on the cranking pulse against the cranking coolant, result into CrankPulseCoolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

05BC.name: CrankBasePulse
05BC.desc: Cranking base pulse width: ethanol content (FlexEthanolScaled, rows) x cranking coolant temperature (columns); squared, then reduced by the decay factors below; into CrankPulse

055A.name: CrankRpmDecay
055A.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm, throttle not closed; weighted by CrankRpmDecayWeight

0564.name: CrankRpmDecayClosed
0564.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm with the throttle closed

057A.name: CrankRpmDecayWeight
057A.desc: Weight of the rpm reduction against the cranking coolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

0582.name: CrankV0769Decay
0582.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against CrankDecayIndex; weighted by CrankV0769DecayWeight

0533.name: CrankVacuumFactor
0533.desc: Cranking pulse factor against manifold vacuum

059B.name: CrankEthanolCoolant
059B.desc: Cranking: value against ethanol content and coolant into CrankEthanolFactor

063D.name: CrankCoolantAdder
063D.desc: Cranking: added to the coolant temperature against the number of crank events (CrankEvents), limited to $0B75; result is the cranking coolant CrankCoolant

0646.name: InjectorDeadTime
0646.desc: Injector dead time against battery voltage

10EE.name: ReturnlessFuelScale
10EE.desc: Global fuel multiplier of the returnless fuel system

1489.name: HotEngineEnrich
1489.desc: Enrichment against coolant above $0BD9 (with rpm, MAP and time above their limits), into HotEnrich; sets FuelModeFlags2 bit 1

1466.name: InjectionModeRpmFactor
1466.desc: Factor against rpm on the bank pulse (FuelPulseBank1 / FuelPulseBank2) during the change of injection mode in FuelEventSchedule

07C2.name: PartThrottleFuel
07C2.desc: Part-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0E5D.name: DecelBaroMapOffset
0E5D.desc: Added to MAP against barometric pressure before DecelMapScale

0A0E.name: DecelMapRpmLimit
0A0E.desc: Deceleration fuel reduction: MAP x rpm threshold; with the throttle closed, values under it ramp DecelFuelFactor (DecelFuelFactor) in

19FB.name: FuelEventRpmAdder
19FB.desc: Pulse width added against rpm while SparkFlags2 bit 7 is set (result x 8)

0F4E.name: WotTimeEnrichMax
0F4E.desc: Maximum of the WOT enrichment that builds up after a sustained WOT (WotTimeEnrich), against rpm

0715.name: WotFuel
0715.desc: Wide-open-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

06F1.name: BaroFuel
06F1.desc: Pulse width added to the fuel pulse against barometric pressure (result x 8)

0661.name: IdleEnrichSoakTime
0661.desc: Idle enrichment against the engine-off time EngineOffTime, into IdleEnrichSoak

0670.name: IdleEnrichRunTime
0670.desc: Idle enrichment against run time (IdleEnrichRun); with the others into IdleEnrichFactor, which multiplies the fuel while FuelModeFlags2 bit 3 is set (low rpm and MAP)

0ABB.name: IdleEnrichEthanolAirTemp
0ABB.desc: Idle enrichment against ethanol content (rows) and intake air temperature at start (StartAirTemp)

0EBE.name: AccelMapCoolant2
0EBE.desc: MAP-rate acceleration enrichment term against coolant into AccelMapCoolantFactor

0ECA.name: AccelMapGainCoolant
0ECA.desc: MAP-rate acceleration enrichment gain against coolant, plus AccelMapGainAdder, into AccelMapGain

0E7F.name: AccelMapBaro
0E7F.desc: MAP-rate acceleration enrichment term against barometric pressure into AccelMapBaroFactor

0E98.name: AccelTpsRateLimit
0E98.desc: Throttle-rate acceleration enrichment: the throttle step above $14B5 is limited to this value, against coolant

0EB0.name: TpsFilterRiseCoolant
0EB0.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast (TpsFilterCoef) while the throttle opens, against coolant at start

0E8B.name: AccelTpsBaro
0E8B.desc: Throttle-rate acceleration enrichment term against barometric pressure into AccelTpsBaroFactor

0E73.name: AccelRpmFactor
0E73.desc: Acceleration enrichment factor against rpm; plus AccelMapAdder, limited to 1.0, into AccelFactor

0440.name: ResetCoolantFuelInit
0440.desc: At reset: ResetCoolantFuel (cranking fuel set-up) against coolant; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

06D8.name: TipInAirTempFactor
06D8.desc: Tip-in enrichment factor against intake air temperature

06E2.name: TipInBaroFactor
06E2.desc: Tip-in enrichment factor against barometric pressure; result (with ReturnlessFuelScale) into TipInFuel and spread over the next injectors

0FA9.name: DecelLeanThrottleCoolantFactor
0FA9.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the throttle-closing term against coolant at start, into DecelLeanThrottleFactor

0FBB.name: DecelLeanMapCoolantFactor
0FBB.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the MAP-drop term against coolant at start, into DecelLeanMapFactor

0F73.name: MapFilterFallCoolant
0F73.desc: Filter coefficient for MapLast (MapFilterCoef) while MAP falls, against coolant at start

0F64.name: TpsFilterFallCoolant
0F64.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast (TpsFilterCoef) while the throttle closes, against coolant at start

4054.name: ResetCoolantInit2
4054.desc: At reset: ResetCoolant2 against coolant temperature; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

0F7B.name: DecelLeanBaroFactor
0F7B.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against barometric pressure; the result, limited by $158A, is DecelLeanFuel; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

0FCD.name: DecelLeanMapAdder
0FCD.desc: Deceleration enleanment: added to DecelLeanRpmFactor against MAP

0FE1.name: DecelLeanRpmFactor
0FE1.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against rpm (with DecelLeanMapAdder)

0FF5.name: DecelLeanAirflow
0FF5.desc: Deceleration enleanment: airflow value against rpm and throttle position; the drop between last and current throttle goes to DecelLeanAir

1091.name: DecelLeanTimeCoolant
1091.desc: Deceleration enleanment shortly after start: time x coolant at start, into DecelLeanTimeFactor

0F0F.name: IacFuelCoolantLimit
0F0F.desc: Above this (against coolant) the extra idle air (IacTargetCmd minus IacPosition) sets FuelModeFlags bit 7 instead of adding fuel

0F19.name: EventFuelCoolantSub
0F19.desc: Per-event fuel: amount subtracted from FuelPulseAdder against coolant while FuelModeFlags bit 7 is set

0EEE.name: IacFuelCoolant
0EEE.desc: Fuel pulse added for extra idle air, rows by IacFuelScale, columns coolant; x 16 into FuelPulseAdder

11D6.name: O2StartDelayCoolant
11D6.desc: Closed-loop entry (O2StartDelays): delay against coolant (plus $323D with an O2 fault flag)

1270.name: O2VoltageScale
1270.desc: Upstream O2 sensor ADC counts to the value used by closed loop and its monitor

12C8.name: O2VoltageScale2
12C8.desc: Second copy of the O2 voltage scale (same values as O2VoltageScale)

11C2.name: O2StepScale
11C2.desc: Closed loop: trim step against the size of the O2 error Scratch3 (doubled while purge is active and duty is zero)

1186.name: DecelCutRpmFactor
1186.desc: Factor on the fuel pulse while the deceleration cut-off flag (FuelModeFlags2 bit 7) is set, against rpm above the idle target

13F7.name: PurgeLearnUpClosed
13F7.desc: Purge vapor learning, closed throttle: step added to PurgeVaporClosed when the trim is above $1B2C

1403.name: PurgeLearnDownClosed
1403.desc: Purge vapor learning, closed throttle: step subtracted from PurgeVaporClosed when the trim is below −$1B2D

13DF.name: PurgeLearnUpPart
13DF.desc: Purge vapor learning, part throttle: step added to PurgeVaporPart when the short-term trim is above $1B2C

13EB.name: PurgeLearnDownPart
13EB.desc: Purge vapor learning, part throttle: step subtracted from PurgeVaporPart when the trim is below −$1B2D

140F.name: PurgeFuelBase
140F.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction base against MAP (rows) and rpm (columns, normalised lookup); multiplied by the learned vapor value PurgeVaporClosed

1679.name: CoolantSparkMap
1679.desc: Spark change against MAP (rows) and coolant (columns), signed

1AF1.name: AirTempSparkFactor
1AF1.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMapRpm against intake air temperature (or BatteryTemp with calibration bit Options0330 bit 5 clear)

1A9C.name: AirTempSparkMapRpm
1A9C.desc: Spark change for intake air temperature, MAP x rpm (signed), scaled by AirTempSparkFactor

1A09.name: AfterStartSparkCoolant
1A09.desc: Spark change after start against the coolant temperature at start, into AfterStartSparkStart

1940.name: AfterStartSparkMapRpm
1940.desc: Spark change after start, MAP x rpm (signed), weighted by AfterStartSparkCoolantWeight

1A2B.name: BaroSpark
1A2B.desc: Spark change against barometric pressure, weighted by BaroSparkRpmWeight

19E5.name: DecelSpark
19E5.desc: Spark change against the deceleration fuel factor (DecelFuelFactor), signed

19F3.name: HighSpeedSparkRpm
19F3.desc: Spark retard against engine rpm above coarse vehicle speed $1FA6 (hysteresis $1FA5)

1D31.name: EventSparkThrottle
1D31.desc: Upper limit of the event spark EventSpark against throttle while EventSparkFlags bits 4 and 2 are set (raised by $205D per loop)

1D3B.name: EventSparkThrottle2
1D3B.desc: As EventSparkThrottle while EventSparkFlags bit 3 is set (raised by $205E per loop)

19C0.name: TipInRetardDuration
19C0.desc: Tip-in spark retard near idle (TipInSparkControl): number of steps (TipInSteps) against air temperature

19DD.name: TipInRetardDurationKnock
19DD.desc: As TipInRetardDuration while a knock retard is applied (KnockRetard non-zero)

19B8.name: TipInRetardAirScale
19B8.desc: Tip-in spark retard: air temperature to row position; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

1BA3.name: SurgeJerkRetardOpen
1BA3.desc: Driveline surge spark control, throttle open: retard against positive rpm jerk (above $2173)

1BAB.name: SurgeJerkAdvanceOpen
1BAB.desc: Driveline surge spark control, throttle open: spark against negative rpm jerk (below $2172)

1BDB.name: SurgeRateThreshold
1BDB.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm acceleration (RpmAccel) that starts the retard, against the rpm/speed ratio (gear)

1BE9.name: SurgeRetardGearFactor
1BE9.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the base retard against the rpm/speed ratio (gear)

1BC3.name: SurgeRetardRateFactor
1BC3.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against rpm acceleration RpmAccel

1BCF.name: SurgeRetardMapRiseFactor
1BCF.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against MAP rise MapRise (MAP minus filtered MAP); result into SurgeRetard

1B3D.name: SurgeRetardBase
1B3D.desc: Driveline surge spark control: base retard (SurgeRetardRaw) against MAP position (rows) and the fast segment rpm SegmentRpmFast (columns)

1B5E.name: SurgeDecay
1B5E.desc: Driveline surge spark control: decay factor of the retard against gear (rows) and time in the decay stage SurgeStageTime (columns)

1BF7.name: SurgeJerkThreshold
1BF7.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm jerk (RpmJerk) above which the jerk retard applies, against the rpm/speed ratio

1B97.name: SurgeRetardCoolantFactor
1B97.desc: Driveline surge spark control: factor on the retard against coolant

1B1C.name: SurgeJerkGain
1B1C.desc: Driveline surge spark control: jerk retard gain against MAP position (rows) and fast rpm (columns)

1AFB.name: SurgeJerkLimit
1AFB.desc: Driveline surge spark control: limit of the jerk retard against MAP position (rows) and fast rpm (columns), into SurgeJerkRetard

1C11.name: AcEngageSparkHoldSensor
1C11.desc: A/C spark compensation: hold count (AcSparkHold) against the A/C sensor (calibration bit Options031E bit 7 set)

1C19.name: AcEngageSparkHoldIac
1C19.desc: As AcEngageSparkHoldSensor against the learned IAC position IacLearned (bit Options031E bit 7 clear)

1C21.name: AcEngageSparkHoldMap
1C21.desc: Factor on the A/C spark hold count against MAP

1C29.name: AcClutchSparkTimeSensor
1C29.desc: A/C clutch engage (AcCutLogic): spark window AcClutchSparkTime against the A/C sensor

1C31.name: AcClutchSparkTimeIac
1C31.desc: As AcClutchSparkTimeSensor against the learned IAC position IacLearned

1C39.name: AcClutchSparkTimeMap
1C39.desc: Factor on the A/C clutch spark window against MAP

1C41.name: AcSparkRateUp
1C41.desc: A/C spark compensation: spark against positive rpm rate RpmRate, into AcSpark

1C49.name: AcSparkRateDown
1C49.desc: As AcSparkRateUp against negative rpm rate, A/C clutch off

1C51.name: AcSparkRateDownAcOn
1C51.desc: As AcSparkRateDown with the A/C clutch on

1C59.name: AcSparkMapLimit
1C59.desc: Limit of the A/C spark compensation against MAP

16D6.name: FlexSparkMapRpm
16D6.desc: Flex-fuel spark change, MAP x rpm, minus FlexSparkValue, weighted by FlexSparkEthanolWeight

1A42.name: FlexSparkEthanolWeight
1A42.desc: Weight of FlexSparkMapRpm against ethanol content

1C8B.name: KnockNoiseLearnWeight
1C8B.desc: Filter weight of the learned knock noise level per rpm band (KnockNoiseLevel)

1C7F.name: KnockWindowRpm
1C7F.desc: Knock sampling window length factor (KnockWindowFactor) against engine rpm; read here with another input than in 05293190AC, so the x unit is not carried

1CA3.name: KnockThreshold
1CA3.desc: Knock sensor voltage threshold against rpm

1CBC.name: KnockRetardStep
1CBC.desc: Knock retard step against the knock signal above the threshold (KnockSignal minus KnockThresholdNow); the value is multiplied by KnockFirstStepFactor or KnockStepFactor

1CB3.name: KnockRetardMaxMap
1CB3.desc: Maximum knock retard (KnockRetardMax) against MAP (above throttle $24A5 or below rpm $24A6)

3DAD.name: KnockRetardMaxRpm
3DAD.desc: Limit of the per-cylinder knock retard (KnockCylRetardMax) against engine rpm

1D96.name: IdleStepClose
1D96.desc: Idle speed control: closing step against the accumulated error, added to IacStepSum (limited by $2611/$2612)

1D9E.name: IdleStepOpen
1D9E.desc: Idle speed control: opening step against the accumulated error, added to IacStepSum

1ADB.name: AirTempSparkFactor2
1ADB.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMap against intake air temperature

1AE5.name: AirTempSparkMap
1AE5.desc: Second air-temperature spark term against MAP (signed), scaled by AirTempSparkFactor2

1DF4.name: IdleTargetRpm
1DF4.desc: Target idle speed against coolant temperature

1DE8.name: IdleTargetRpmPN
1DE8.desc: Target idle speed against coolant in P/N (with calibration bit Options0325 bit 6 clear)

1E08.name: IdleTargetHotAirAdder
1E08.desc: Idle target addition against air temperature above $265A (hysteresis down to $2659)

1ECD.name: IdleBattTempTarget
1ECD.desc: Ramped idle target (IdleTargetRamped) against battery temperature (rows) and run time IdleRunTimer (columns)

1E18.name: IdleRateFilterCoolant
1E18.desc: Idle speed control: filter weight of the rpm rate term (IdleRpmRateFiltered) against coolant

1E32.name: IdleErrorTermFine
1E32.desc: Idle speed control: proportional term against the fine rpm error, used for errors below $26EC

1E68.name: IdleDeadbandCoolant
1E68.desc: Idle speed control: part of the action threshold (IdleDeadband) against coolant

1E72.name: IdleDeadbandMap
1E72.desc: Idle speed control: part of the action threshold (IdleDeadband) against MAP

1E7C.name: IdleStepOpenScale
1E7C.desc: Idle speed control: accumulated error to the size of an IAC opening step

1E86.name: IdleStepOpenFactor
1E86.desc: Idle speed control: opening step factor against the coarse rpm error, into IdleStepOpenValue

1E90.name: IdleStepCloseScale
1E90.desc: Idle speed control: accumulated error to the size of an IAC closing step

1E9A.name: IdleStepCloseFactor
1E9A.desc: Idle speed control: closing step factor against the coarse rpm error, into IdleStepCloseValue

1F44.name: ShiftIdleDelayCoolant
1F44.desc: Delay (ShiftIdleDelay) on a shift into P/N against coolant (above $279B)

1F4E.name: IacGearDelayCoolant
1F4E.desc: Delay timer (IacGearDelay) started when DriveFlags bit 7 sets, against coolant

1F62.name: IacGearTimeFactor
1F62.desc: Factor on IacGearTimeCoolant against the time counter IacGearTime

1F6C.name: IacDroopStepCoolant
1F6C.desc: IAC opening when the rpm drops below the target in gear (IdleFlags3 bit 3, DriveFlags bit 7), against coolant

1F7E.name: IacGearTimeCoolantPNAC
1F7E.desc: As IacGearTimeCoolant in P/N with A/C requested

1F88.name: IacGearTimeFactorPNAC
1F88.desc: As IacGearTimeFactor in P/N with A/C requested

1FA5.name: IacAcKickMap
1FA5.desc: IAC step when the A/C clutch engages, against MAP (MAP latched into IacAcKickMapLatch); into IacKick

1FAD.name: IacAcKickMapLatched
1FAD.desc: IAC step when the A/C clutch releases, against the MAP latched at engagement (IacAcKickMapLatch)

1EFE.name: IacStartBattTemp
1EFE.desc: IAC hold at start (IacStartHold/IacStartHold2) against battery temperature, scaled by IacStepBaroFactor

1FC7.name: IacRunTimeAdder
1FC7.desc: IAC addition against time since start

1FCF.name: IacCoastCoolant
1FCF.desc: Minimum idle air while coasting against coolant; the higher of this and IacCoastSpeedRpm applies

1FDD.name: IacCoastThrottleLimit
1FDD.desc: Throttle opening limit for the coasting idle air

2069.name: IacRollSpeedBase
2069.desc: IAC target while rolling: base against vehicle speed

2075.name: IacRollFactorAcSensor
2075.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against the filtered A/C sensor AcSensorFiltered (centred on 128), with calibration bit Options031E bit 7

2081.name: IacRollFactorBattTemp
2081.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against battery temperature (centred on 128)

208B.name: IacRollRpmFactor2
208B.desc: Second rolling IAC factor against segment rpm

2095.name: IacRollRpmFactor
2095.desc: Factor on the rolling IAC target against segment rpm

209F.name: IacRollThrottleRpm
209F.desc: IAC target while rolling: addition against throttle (rows) and segment rpm (signed); result into IacTarget limited by $2642

1FE7.name: IacCoastSpeedRpm
1FE7.desc: Minimum idle air while coasting against vehicle speed (rows) and segment rpm

21E8.name: IacStepBaroFactor
21E8.desc: Multiplier on IAC steps and start positions against barometric pressure

21F2.name: IacShiftBaroFactor
21F2.desc: Multiplier on the gear-change IAC step and the initial IAC value against barometric pressure

21FC.name: IacKickBaroFactor
21FC.desc: Factor on the A/C and rpm-dip IAC steps against barometric pressure

2044.name: IacFieldDutyRpm
2044.desc: IAC addition against field duty (rows) and segment rpm (columns), into Scratch4

20D1.name: IdleMapAfterStart
20D1.desc: Idle MAP target addition against time since start

20DB.name: IdleMapWarmup
20DB.desc: Idle MAP target addition against coolant

20EB.name: IdleMapRpm
20EB.desc: Idle MAP target addition against segment rpm, weighted by IdleMapRpmCoolantWeight

20FF.name: IdleMapBaro
20FF.desc: Idle MAP target addition against barometric pressure

212A.name: IacMapHighStepClosed
212A.desc: IAC closing step against how far MAP is above the idle MAP target, closed throttle

213E.name: IacMapLowStep
213E.desc: IAC opening step against how far MAP is below the idle MAP target (IdleMapTarget)

2148.name: IdleMapAdderIac
2148.desc: Idle MAP target addition against the learned IAC position IacLearned (without A/C clutch)

2152.name: IdleMapAdderIac2
2152.desc: As IdleMapAdderIac when FuelModeFlags2 bits 7-6 are not both clear and IdleMapIacFlag is zero

2109.name: IacFieldDutyRpm2
2109.desc: Second field-duty table against segment rpm, into Scratch7 (MAP offset for the learned idle MAP)

21B5.name: IdleMapBase
21B5.desc: Base of the idle MAP target (IdleMapTarget, via Scratch5): barometric pressure (rows) and idle target rpm (columns)

2180.name: IacDriveOffsetBaro
2180.desc: IAC offset removed from the IAC target in drive, against barometric pressure, giving IacDriveOffset

21AD.name: IacStartBaro
21AD.desc: Idle air position at reset against barometric pressure, into IdleMapLearned

1DC0.name: IacCoastMapGain
1DC0.desc: Coasting IAC target: gain of the MAP error (MAP minus learned idle MAP IdleMapLearned) against barometric pressure

218C.name: IacBaseBaroTarget
218C.desc: Base idle air (IAC position) against barometric pressure (rows) and the idle target (columns), into IacBase; added to the IAC target

227E.name: SpeedCtlEngageBaro
227E.desc: Factor on the engagement position against barometric pressure

228C.name: SpeedCtlEngageErrorAdder
228C.desc: Correction of the engagement position against the speed error (set speed minus speed, centred on 128)

229E.name: SpeedCtlThrottleTerm
229E.desc: Servo term against throttle above closed ($03,Y)

22A6.name: SpeedCtlSpeedTerm
22A6.desc: Servo term against raw vehicle speed ×8, added to SpeedCtlThrottleTerm

2228.name: SpeedCtlErrorGain
2228.desc: Servo step against the speed error (one of the error curves of SpeedCtlControl, by SpeedCtlState bits 2-3)

22AE.name: SpeedCtlCancelStep
22AE.desc: Step against speed plus 4 minus the set speed, when the set speed is replaced by the current speed

2244.name: SpeedCtlErrorGainResume
2244.desc: Servo step against the speed error with SpeedCtlState bit 4 set

22F3.name: SpeedCtlOverrideThrottle
22F3.desc: Value SpeedCtlOverrideCmd against throttle above the level latched in SpeedCtlShiftThrottle (driver override)

0507.name: MisfireLoadScale
